payload.text: The tap's CI runs brew style and brew audit --strict again (hv's ISSUE:0004 ruling 3). hv's OK to push came on 2026-11-16 ("do it now", decision 9), and vc passed it to dc the same minute: dc pushes 434d105 (test.yml alone, back to 65cac20's exactly) from its scratch clone to the tap's main, by fast-forward from cf77911, and reports the tap's CI on macos-15 and ubuntu-22.04.
